description: Split from task-da60dc4b by governor ruling 21:25Z on worker-deb4c7d8's measurement: `apps/daemon/src/deployment/rollback-command.ts:86-88` refuses `DEPLOY_ROLLBACK_DATABASE_RESTORE_UNAVAILABLE` ("no database restoration port is bound to the selected deployment environment") because `BackupPorts.restoreDatabase` (task-95e68a8d, DONE) only verifies a dump inside a temporary isolated database and has no bound production destination. This row binds the destination and makes both arms real. task-da60dc4b keeps the refusal's code+layer assertion and the no-restore-call assertion.
definitionOfDone: A production restore destination is bound per deployment environment (the selected environment's database, resolved through the existing environment credential seam - never process.env, never a browser-supplied URL); an environment with no bound destination keeps refusing `DEPLOY_ROLLBACK_DATABASE_RESTORE_UNAVAILABLE` with code AND layer.

`deployment.rollback` with `restore: true` applies the recorded backup (the one named by the kept deploy receipt / backupRef) to that destination and the rollback receipt says so; `restore` not requested records NO restore call on the port - both arms asserted from the port's recorded calls.
A restore that fails leaves the schema as it was and the receipt REFUSED with the failing step named (code + layer); no automatic retry, no partial apply.
